candidates.description: This vector represents Italian verb forms, predominantly auxiliary and linking verbs in various conjugations and tenses.
This vector activates on various types of quotation marks, parentheses, and punctuation used to set off text or speech.
This vector represents common punctuation marks and trailing symbol combinations used at the ends of sentences and clauses.
This feature vector activates strongly for names of influential historical philosophers, authors, and thinkers.
This feature vector activates on common linguistic suffixes, prefixes, and morphological roots starting with the letters "ent".
This vector is related to Italian possessive adjectives and pronouns.
These tokens represent common German and European given names or name components.
This vector represents the concept of human beings and individual people across different languages and grammatical forms.
This feature vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, particularly those related to the morpheme "-ment" across Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on the Latin root 'per-' and its common morphological variations across multiple languages.
